bindingTestSummary.samplingTimeMissing: Aripiprazole t1/2 75h, interval 24h -> within-interval swing 1.25x (+-12%), vs between-subject C/D spread 4.5-4.7x and genotype effect 1.59x: gap does NOT bind for aripiprazole C/D classification. Clozapine t1/2 16h, interval 12h -> 1.68x: P2 clozapine 721 spans 429-1211 across the 600 upper bound and 1000 alert level: gap BINDS for clozapine/paliperidone out-of-range classification; protocol reports intervals and sensitivity.
bindingTestSummary.frequencyCoding: BID4 and overlapping-brand ambiguity give 2x daily-dose range; P4 aripiprazole C/D moves 20-40 ng/mL/mg, both ends in the slow-metabolizer band: classification robust.
bindingTestSummary.noOutcomeScale: Efficacy outcome absent by 100% (no scale field, DIAGNOSTIC_CONTENT empty, DIS_RESULT constant, no follow-up); fallback = toxicity proxies (clozapine 1000 ng/mL PMID 9068925; olanzapine 20.6 ng/mL PMID 15876904; EPS via anticholinergic orders).
bindingTestSummary.predictionModel: Training a popPK/ML model infeasible: n=5/22 samples, no sampling times, no administration records, no genotype, no validation set; prediction-interval ~10x vs therapeutic window 3.3x; fallback = descriptive C/D positioning (Q1) + external-model simulation (Q6a) explicitly unvalidated.
